Before

Heard Ms S Dey, learned counsel appearing on behalf of Mr N H Barbhuiya.

Also heard
Mr P Hazarikia, learned Government Advocate, Assam, appearing on behalf of the State
respondents.
2. This

writ petition had been initiated in the year 2020, praying for directions to the respondent authorities to take appropriate action with regard to Dispur PS Case No. 785 of 2019, under Sections 420/406 of the IPC and to arrest the accused person immediately.
An affidavit-in-opposition has been filed by the respondent State, stating Page No.# 3/3 that the investigation was being conducted.
Today, Mr Hazarika has submitted that he may be allowed an opportunity to get the up-to-date status.

3. List this matter again on 12th of December, 2025, by which time, appropriate instructions regarding the fate of Dispur PS Case No. 785 of 2019, under Sections 420/406 of the IPC, shall be placed before this Court.
4.
In the meantime, the learned counsel for the petitioner shall also have instructions as to whether any further adjudication is required in this writ petition.
